questions.question_english: Can an employee under suspension be granted leave (e.g., Earned Leave or Casual Leave)?
options_english: No, leave cannot be granted to a Government servant under suspension.
Yes, leave can be granted by the Disciplinary Authority.
Yes, but only Medical Leave can be granted.
Yes, leave can be granted provided the employee waives the subsistence allowance.
questions.explanation_english: No, leave cannot be granted to a Government servant under suspension. Under Fundamental Rule 55 and statutory service guidelines, leave of any kind, including Earned Leave, Casual Leave, or Medical Leave, cannot be granted to a government servant who is under suspension. Suspension temporarily holds the employee’s active duty status in abeyance, preventing any leave from being sanctioned during this period.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। निलंबन के तहत एक सरकारी कर्मचारी को छुट्टी नहीं दी जा सकती। मौलिक नियम 55 और वैधानिक सेवा दिशानिर्देशों के तहत, किसी भी प्रकार की छुट्टी, जिसमें अर्जित छुट्टी, आकस्मिक छुट्टी या चिकित्सा छुट्टी शामिल है, निलंबन के तहत एक सरकारी कर्मचारी को नहीं दी जा सकती। निलंबन अस्थायी रूप से कर्मचारी की सक्रिय ड्यूटी स्थिति को निलंबित कर देता है, जिससे इस अवधि के दौरान किसी भी छुट्टी को स्वीकृत करने से रोका जाता है।
key_facts: Fundamental Rule 55 prohibits granting leave during suspension.
Suspension halts active duty status.
No leave of any kind is permissible under suspension.
Printed answer key: (A) No, leave cannot be granted to a Government servant under suspension.

questions.question_english: Upon the expiry of the period of reduction to a lower grade (as a major penalty), if the order states that the employee will NOT regain his original seniority, what is the effect on the employee?
options_english: The employee must clear a fresh competitive recruitment examination to re-enter the higher grade.
The employee is restored to the higher grade but placed at the very bottom of the seniority list.

questions.explanation_english: When the period of reduction to a lower grade ends, the employee is restored to the higher grade. questions.question_english: Who is the lowest competent authority to impose the penalty of compulsory retirement on a Government servant?
options_english: The Appointing Authority or an authority not subordinate to it

questions.explanation_english: Under Article 311(1) of the Constitution and Rule 11 of the CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965, major penalties that terminate service, including compulsory retirement, removal, and dismissal, can only be imposed by the Appointing Authority or an authority higher than the appointing authority, never by a subordinate authority.

questions.question_english: A Head Clerk in a school manipulates accounts and embezzles Rs. 5 Lakhs. A departmental inquiry proves the charge beyond doubt. The Appointing Authority orders his dismissal from service. The clerk appeals, stating that since it was his first offence, he should have been allowed to resign. Is the Appointing Authority’s decision legally sound under the CCS (CCA) Rules?
options_english: Yes, embezzlement warrants dismissal, and resignation is not a right during proceedings.
No, first-time administrative offences cannot legally attract the extreme penalty of dismissal from service.
No, the appointing authority must offer the employee an option for voluntary retirement before dismissing him.
Yes, but the authority is mandated to refund the entire embezzled sum directly into the clerk’s GPF account.
questions.explanation_english: Serious financial embezzlement warrants major penalties, including dismissal. Resignation is not a statutory right of an employee facing disciplinary proceedings, and the Appointing Authority is fully within its powers under Rule 11 and Article 311 to reject resignation requests and impose dismissal following proven inquiry findings.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। गंभीर वित्तीय गबन के लिए प्रमुख दंड, जिसमें बर्खास्तगी शामिल है, की आवश्यकता होती है। अनुशासनात्मक कार्यवाही का सामना कर रहे कर्मचारी का इस्तीफा देना एक वैधानिक अधिकार नहीं है, और नियुक्ति प्राधिकरण नियम 11 और अनुच्छेद 311 के तहत इस्तीफे के अनुरोधों को अस्वीकार करने और सिद्ध जांच निष्कर्षों के बाद बर्खास्तगी लगाने के लिए पूरी तरह से अपने अधिकारों में है।
key_facts: Rule 11 allows for dismissal in cases of serious misconduct.
Article 311 protects the authority's right to dismiss without allowing resignation.
Printed answer key: (A) Yes, embezzlement warrants dismissal, and resignation is not a right during proceedings.

Consider the following statements regarding the Complaints Committee for addressing sexual harassment under the CCS rules:
I. The Complaints Committee established in a Ministry or Department for inquiring into complaints of sexual harassment shall be deemed to be the Inquiring Authority appointed by the Disciplinary Authority.
II. The report of the Complaints Committee shall be treated as an inquiry report under the CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965.
III. The Disciplinary Authority must initiate a fresh, separate formal departmental inquiry even after the Complaints Committee submits its report.
IV. The Complaints Committee’s findings are only advisory and cannot lead to major penalties.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
I and IV only
I, II and IV only
questions.explanation_english: All of the statements are correct. The Complaints Committee acts as the Inquiring Authority, and its report is treated as an inquiry report under the CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965. Even though the Disciplinary Authority may choose to initiate a separate inquiry, the findings of the Complaints Committee are indeed advisory and can lead to major penalties depending on the circumstances. Therefore, all statements I, II, and IV are accurate.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। सभी बयानों में सत्यता है। शिकायत समिति जांच प्राधिकरण के रूप में कार्य करती है, और इसकी रिपोर्ट को CCS (CCA) नियम, 1965 के तहत एक जांच रिपोर्ट के रूप में माना जाता है। हालांकि अनुशासनात्मक प्राधिकरण एक अलग जांच शुरू कर सकता है, शिकायत समिति के निष्कर्ष केवल सलाहकार होते हैं और परिस्थितियों के आधार पर प्रमुख दंडों का कारण बन सकते हैं। इसलिए, सभी बयानों I, II और IV सही हैं।

questions.question_english: Identify the incorrect statement regarding the scope of the CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965.
options_english: They provide the framework for the classification of services.
They detail the procedures for imposing minor and major penalties.
They prescribe the substantive code of conduct for government employees.
They specify the appellate authorities for various disciplinary actions.
questions.explanation_english: The Central Civil Services (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules, 1965 focus on classification of posts, procedural aspects of disciplinary actions, penalties, and appeals. Substantive rules governing employee conduct, duties, and restrictions are separately contained within the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964. Thus, conduct rules define misconduct, while classification and control rules prescribe procedures for taking action.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा (वर्गीकरण, नियंत्रण और अपील) नियम, 1965 पदों के वर्गीकरण, अनुशासनात्मक कार्यवाहियों, दंड और अपीलों के प्रक्रियात्मक पहलुओं पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हैं। कर्मचारियों के आचार, कर्तव्यों और प्रतिबंधों के लिए मौलिक नियम अलग से केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा (आचार) नियम, 1964 में निहित हैं। इस प्रकार, आचार नियम misconduct को परिभाषित करते हैं, जबकि वर्गीकरण और नियंत्रण नियम कार्रवाई करने की प्रक्रियाएँ निर्धारित करते हैं।
key_facts: CCS (CCA) Rules focus on procedural aspects and classification.

Printed answer key: (C) They prescribe the substantive code of conduct for government employees.

questions.question_english: What is the full form of the CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965, which govern the disciplinary mechanisms for Central Government servants?
options_english: Central Civil Services (Conduct, Control and Appeal) Rules
Central Civil Services (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules
Central Civil Services (Categorisation, Conduct and Appeal) Rules
Central Civil Services (Classification, Conduct and Authority) Rules
questions.explanation_english: The Central Civil Services (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules, 1965 provide the administrative framework governing disciplinary proceedings for Union Government servants. These statutory rules categorize government posts, delineate disciplinary authorities, establish procedure for minor and major penalties, and define appellate and revisionary mechanisms to ensure fair treatment, public accountability, and adherence to constitutional provisions across central government services.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। केंद्रीय नागरिक सेवाएँ (वर्गीकरण, नियंत्रण और अपील) नियम, 1965 संघ सरकार के कर्मचारियों के लिए अनुशासनात्मक कार्यवाही को नियंत्रित करने के लिए प्रशासनिक ढांचा प्रदान करते हैं। ये वैधानिक नियम सरकारी पदों को वर्गीकृत करते हैं, अनुशासनात्मक प्राधिकरणों को स्पष्ट करते हैं, छोटे और बड़े दंडों के लिए प्रक्रिया स्थापित करते हैं, और केंद्रीय सरकार की सेवाओं में उचित उपचार, सार्वजनिक जवाबदेही और संवैधानिक प्रावधानों के पालन को सुनिश्चित करने के लिए अपीलीय और पुनरीक्षण तंत्र को परिभाषित करते हैं।
key_facts: CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965 govern disciplinary actions for Central Government employees.
Printed answer key: (B) Central Civil Services (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules
